meta.name: The Crow Club
meta.description: Four couples form part of the mysterious Crow Club, where supernatural cases and dangerous missions lead to unexpected romantic bonds.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Four members of The Crow Club must decide on a new job that threatens the club's strict rules, and involves people and feelings best avoided.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: While work forces Tangmo and his ex together, Vann helps Rakkhur with his troubled love life, and Phatee's new assignment reunites him with Run.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Vann uncovers what's truly behind Rakkhun's relationship woes, but as he digs deeper he finds it difficult to separate the job from his feelings.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: To help Rakkhun, Vann makes a dangerous deal that puts his own life at stake – and forces both men to confront their true feelings.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Old feelings resurface as Phatee prepares to work with Ranne again — a senior he secretly liked back when they were in school.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Phatee tries to advance his art career, but problems within the group and deep feelings for Ranne force him to decide which dreams he wants to pursue.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: When Ranne finally suspects the truth about Phatee's feelings, Phatee tries to deny them. Meanwhile, a major crisis threatens the Crow Club's future.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Lies about an old scandal resurface, and Phatee sees his lofty personal aspirations undercut overnight when the hashtag #BanPhatee begins trending.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: A reality TV show based on the classic Werewolf party game turns dangerously real for Tangmo and Yoyeh, forcing the exes to work together to survive.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: As the game viciously eliminates rival players, Tangmo uses his role as a bodyguard to protect Yoyeh — but their shared past make trust hard for both.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: With the game growing ever more dangerous, Tangmo fights to protect Yoyeh — without considering that the person he trusts most might be the final wolf.
